## ExecutableTrustStatus.trusted property

Whether the executable's current hash is approved in the trust manifest. When `false`<!-- -->, callers must obtain approval (e.g. an interactive prompt) before granting secret access.

**Signature:**

```typescript
trusted: boolean;
```
